user.title: Govee Local Plus
user.description: Scans the LAN for Govee lights with LAN control enabled (Govee Home app > device settings). Port 4002/UDP must be free: stop the Govee to MQTT bridge first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Govee Local Plus entry is needed, it covers every light.
abort.no_devices_found: No Govee light answered. Enable LAN control in the Govee Home app and check that nothing else holds UDP port 4002.

init.title: Custom segment effects
init.description: Static colour layouts that are painted locally, one JSON object. Segments are 0-based. Example: {"Signal-Rot": {"background": [0,0,0], "fills": [{"color": [234,51,35], "segments": [10, 11]}]}}

bind_failed.message: Could not listen for Govee devices: {error}

no_devices_found.message: No Govee light found on the network

no_listening_addresses.message: No enabled network adapter has an IPv4 address to listen on

port_in_use.message: Port {port} is already in use (the Govee to MQTT bridge or the built-in Govee integration?)
